main_limitation: Fail-before/pass-after needs the historical environment; a silent wrong result needs an independent expected value, not only the fix's own test
Open-ended requirements and multiple admissible implementations can limit what one selected reference establishes about acceptance
Depends on external package versions of the time; conversions need semantic comparison across frameworks
Timing depends on hardware and environment; correctness has to be held fixed while speed is measured
Behavior preservation needs verification of affected contracts beyond a mere build
The deliverable is a test; judging it needs evidence that it detects defects, for example mutation testing
Verification requires running CI or packaging infrastructure
The labels propose example/build/UI verification and content review; their completeness and automatic scorability are unvalidated
